order: Four corpus/lane treatments in cyclic Latin order repeated four times; every treatment occupies each position four times.

analysis.within_child: Four sequential 50-sample means and half means; descriptive spans.
analysis.between_children: Sixteen process summaries per corpus and lane; (max-min)/min.
analysis.process_probe: 32 empty adjacent snapshot counter controls before warmup; per-operation process metric vectors. No control durations are collected. Never subtract control quantiles or compare instrumented elapsed as native latency.
analysis.phase_fault_summary: Per-child minor/major fault distributions aligned with elapsed samples and empty controls; paired elapsed summaries for exact fault buckets, no causal inference.

limits: No optimization candidate or acceptance gate; 0715 rejection unchanged.
Native lane carries instrumentation none; procfs lane has separate feature/binary/identity and its elapsed values are diagnostic only.
Process snapshots bracket allocator region and timer but include procfs probe overhead; after snapshot precedes owner drop and digest verification.
32 empty counter controls precede warmups and are never subtracted from operation observations.
CPU tick resolution can exceed the operation duration; do not derive fine-grained CPU utilization or hardware counters.
RSS delta is a nonnegative endpoint delta; VmHWM is process-lifetime high water, not operation peak.
One fresh process per job, 200 in-process samples; generic filesystem isolation flags do not describe this route.
Rust hash seeds, allocator/ASLR layout, and unlisted environment variables remain uncontrolled.
No exclusions, replacement children, stop-on-good-result, cold cache, throughput, scaling or causal claims.
External wait4/context retains whole-process observations separately from operation probe.
Counters are same-process observations, not owner-exclusive; other activity reflected by each procfs field can contribute.
Empty controls record counter deltas only. Their wall-clock durations are not measured and they do not quantify latency overhead.
